verdict.rationale: Close's developer docs mention an integrations directory where third-party OAuth apps can be listed, which implies a first-party marketplace of prebuilt integrations. There is no evidence of what it contains or how an ops user installs from it. The data-warehouse mention describes pulling data via the API, a developer building block rather than a prebuilt integration, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of an end-user installable marketplace, specific prebuilt Slack, support desk, marketing and data warehouse integrations, an install flow, and independent corroboration.
